title: Update a store code
summary: Change a store's unique code in HQ Admin, and update it in AEM first if AEM is your content management system.
bodyMd:
The store code is the key that ties a store to its Retail Admin staff users and to connected systems such as Google Business Profile and other Internal Systems. You change it on the store's Store Details tab in HQ Admin.

Before you begin


Steps


Store codes are how Retail Admin staff users are associated with their store and how the platform matches stores in connected systems. After changing a code, check that the same code is used in your retail-staff-user upload and in Google Business Profile.

Verify it worked

The Stores / Branches list shows the new value in the Store Code column for that store. Use the copy icon next to it to paste the code into other systems.
